@soundnessError_bound : ∀ {Root ι F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F]
  [inst_3 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] {r : ℕ} {D : Type} (P : SoundnessParams)
  (foldRoot : Root → F → Root → Root) (dom : ι ↪ F) {dd : ℕ} {A₀ : AccClaim Root F ι r} {T : ℕ}
  {chs : Fin T → Chain Root F ι r} {qs : List (LcQuery Root F ι r)} {wss : Fin T → List (ι → F)} {f0s : Fin T → ι → F}
  {δ dC : ℝ} {prover honest : Fin P.depth → ℕ → Polynomial F} {Hc Sc : Fin P.depth → F}
  (Adv : BreakAdversary D P.hashQueries (2 ^ P.hashBits)) (pf : Fin 2 → ι → F),
  dd ≤ Fintype.card ι →
    qs.Nodup →
      (∀ (i : Fin T) (k : Fin (List.length (chs i))), linkPrefix A₀ (chs i) ↑k ∈ qs) →
        (∀ (i : Fin T), List.length (chs i) ≤ P.depth) →
          (∀ (i : Fin T), chs i ≠ []) →
            Function.Injective chs →
              (∀ (i : Fin T), Aligned A₀ (chs i)) →
                (∀ u ∈ reedSolomonCode dom dd, ∀ v ∈ reedSolomonCode dom dd, u ≠ v → dC ≤ relDist u v) →
                  0 < δ →
                    δ < 1 - (2 + ↑dd / ↑(Fintype.card ι)) / 3 →
                      δ < dC / 2 →
                        (∀ (i : Fin T), (wss i).length = List.length (chs i)) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin T),
                              ∃ p ∈ List.zip (chs i) (wss i),
                                ∀ v ∈ reedSolomonCode dom dd,
                                  relDist p.2 v ≤ δ → ¬AccClaim.Satisfies (reedSolomonCode dom dd) p.1.claim v) →
                            ∀ (dflt : (i : Fin T) → Fin (List.length (chs i)) → F),
                              (∀ (j : Fin P.depth), ∀ i < P.scRounds, (prover j i).degree < ↑(P.scDegree + 1)) →
                                (∀ (j : Fin P.depth), ∀ i < P.scRounds, (honest j i).degree < ↑(P.scDegree + 1)) →
                                  (∀ (j : Fin P.depth) (rv : Fin P.scRounds → F),
                                      ∀ i < P.scRounds,
                                        Polynomial.eval 0 (honest j i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest j i) =
                                          scChain (Sc j) (honest j) (chalOf rv) i) →
                                    P.fieldCard = Fintype.card F →
                                      P.codeLen = Fintype.card ι →
                                        P.queries = qs.length →
                                          (uniformProb
                                              ((Fin qs.length → F) ×
                                                (Fin P.depth → Fin P.scRounds → F) ×
                                                  (Fin P.hashQueries → Fin (2 ^ P.hashBits)) × F)
                                              fun c =>
                                              (∃ i w, ⋯ ∧ ⋯) ∨
                                                (∃ j, AcceptsFalse (prover j) (honest j) (Hc j) (Sc j) ⋯) ∨
                                                  Adv.Wins ⋯ ∨ MutualCAFailure (reedSolomonCode dom dd) δ pf ⋯) ≤
                                            soundnessError P
deployedBudget_secure : soundnessError deployedBudget ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 55
deployedBudget_grinding_dominant : sumcheckTerm deployedBudget + crTerm deployedBudget + proximityTerm deployedBudget ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 100 ∧
  1 / 2 ^ 56 < grindingTerm deployedBudget
